schema_note: Meal plan data for two people (amel, nina). 'ingredients' is the catalog; 'meals' holds every meal with item amounts (g, ml or pcs; 'state' says raw, cooked, dry or drained) and kcal, protein_g, carbs_g, fat_g and fibre_g computed from the catalog. 'plans.amel.days' is one repeating week (same meals daily, training type per day). 'plans.nina.weeks' is a 2-week rotation, Sunday to Saturday, where only lunch changes. 'recipes' has the homemade bread (gf_bread_slice maps to 1/10 loaf). 'shopping_lists' are generated from the plans and cover both people. 'reintroduction_schedule' is a separate track that tests foods on top of Amel's baseline lunch. All dairy is lactose-free. Weights are metric.

meta.macros: All five macros (kcal, protein_g, carbs_g, fat_g, fibre_g) are computed from the ingredient catalog. Meal and day totals are derived, not authoritative. Catalog values are typical figures; items with label_check=true should be checked against the product label.

known_issues: Bread is now computed from the loaf recipe for both people: 200.3 kcal per 70 g slice (the earlier fixed value was 186 kcal). Amel's breakfast previously assumed ~80 kcal per slice.
Amel's dinner pancakes were reduced to 50% of the original recipe (from 75%), putting his baseline day at about 2,168 kcal and 182 g protein, below the 2,250 kcal target and the 200 g protein target.
Nina's pancakes use whey instead of isolate and the lamb values are rough, so those macros are less certain.
Nina's day averages about 1,795 kcal before snacks; the assumed snack (1 apple + 20 g nuts) brings it to about 2,010.
Veg mix split (50 g cucumber, 50 g leafy greens, 50 g broccoli, 25 g radish, 25 g tomato) and sauce amounts are assumptions.
Carbs, fat and fibre were added from typical values. Branded or variable items are flagged label_check=true.
shopping_lists were generated before the bread, macro and pancake changes and are stale. The app generates its own lists from plans and ignores this section.
